tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Developer | Java, Spring, REST APIs & Enterprise Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, Git, Docker, and frontend web integrations. Proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, production troubleshooting, and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Shopware Developer (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: Webmatch's reputation for engineering scalable e-commerce platforms with a modern tech stack makes this role an ideal match for my background. Over the past 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have built, integrated, and optimized large-scale enterprise e-commerce platforms and backend services.

bullets.label: E-Commerce & Interfaces
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services, headless APIs, and customized Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless data flows across enterprise systems.

bullets.label: Integration & APIs
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized complex data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to synchronize product catalogs across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Git & Docker Workflows
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds within agile DevOps workflows, utilizing Git and Docker for reliable platform deployments on cloud portals.

bullets.label: Technical Conception
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional capacity with business and technical stakeholders to analyse requirements, design data flows, and translate them into robust technical solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am serving notice until 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my enterprise e-commerce experience can contribute to Webmatch.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Shopware Developer (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Webmatchs Expertise in der Entwicklung skalierbarer E-Commerce-Plattformen mit modernem Tech Stack passt hervorragend zu meinem Profil. In den letzten 5+ Jahren bei Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich erfolgreich großflächige E-Commerce-Plattformen und performante Backend-Schnittstellen entwickelt und optimiert.

bullets.label: Plattform-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Entwicklung von Backend- und Frontend-Funktionalitäten für Enterprise-E-Commerce-Plattformen unter Verwendung von Java, Spring und modernen Entwurfsmustern.

bullets.label: Schnittstellen & APIs
bullets.text: Konzeption und Bereitstellung von REST-Webdiensten und OCC-APIs sowie Integration von Systemen über Dateipipelines und Hotfolders.

bullets.label: Git & Docker
bullets.text: Routinierter Umgang mit Git und Ausführung von CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen sowie Release-Builds innerhalb agiler DevOps-Prozesse.

bullets.label: Technische Konzeption
bullets.text: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen technischen Teams und Fachabteilungen zur Analyse von Integrationsanforderungen und Erstellung technischer Lösungen.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer Kündigungsfrist mit letztem Arbeitstag 15.12.2026 (frühester Eintrittstermin 16.12.2026). Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: Webmatch builds scalable e-commerce platforms using modern technology stacks, matching my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce platform engineering, API integration, and backend development experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce architecture, robust API integration, and robust software engineering practices to Webmatch's scalable platform projects.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years building and integrating large-scale e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the Shopware Developer role at Webmatch. I bring strong API, Git, and Docker experience. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application for the Shopware Developer position at Webmatch GmbH. With over 5 years of professional experience building and integrating large enterprise e-commerce platforms, REST APIs, and backend architectures at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong technical expertise in system integration, Git, and Docker workflows.

My CV and cover letter are attached. I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
